_note: The scripted model for demo (e) (standins/model.mjs). Told Nataliia is home in the living room, it calls the thermostat's target.set with the temperature the delivered instruction's rule states — "keep the living room at <N> °C while she is in it", where <N> is the document's nataliia_temp parameter as agentd rendered it — then says what it did. No number is written here: under v1 it sets 23, under v2 24.5. The real model reads the rooms first and decides; this one copies.

rules.name: said

celsius.re: keep the living room at ([0-9.]+) °C while she is in it

rules.content: Welcome home, Nataliia. I set the living room to {{celsius}} °C: your rule says the living room is kept at {{celsius}} °C while you are in it.

celsius.re: keep the living room at ([0-9.]+) °C while she is in it
